notes.title: My new game: Midnight Sin
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I'm really excited to announce my third game "Midnight Sin" to all of you![/p][p]After another 3 years of development, it's almost ready for release.[/p][p]You can check out the trailer and store page [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3877070/Midnight_Sin/"]here![/url][/p][p]It would [b]really[/b] help me if you would add the game to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][p]I expect the game to be ready for release early 2026.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for the amazing support for both Man of the House and Mystwood Manor![/p][p]I hope you will enjoy Midnight Sin just as much.[/p][p][/p][p]All the best,[/p][p]Faerin[/p]

notes.title: v1.1.1 - Interactive sex toy support
notes.notes:
Hey everybody,

This update enables support for Lovense interactive sex toys.

Their toys will automatically respond to the sex scenes in Mystwood Manor and adjust their movement, depending on the animation speed you select.

And to celebrate our collaboration and the launch of Mystwood Manor, they have offered a big discount if you order from within the game (main menu -> Lovense), that will last until the 25th of November!

Have fun!

notes.title: Mystwood Manor update v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I fixed a bug causing the "Time to talk" event not to trigger for some players.
As well as some minor typos and bugs.

Thanks a lot for all the positive feedback so far, I hope you will continue to enjoy the game!

All the best,
Faerin

notes.title: Don't forget to level up your guests!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Some players seem to have missed the part in the tutorial (and the reminder, later on) where Julia explains how to level up your guests. 

So for those of you who don't see much happening, or can't advance the storylines, check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2870158177]this [/url]post by sycho_3wd1337!

notes.notes:
